scripts._comment:build: build:assets is deliberately NOT part of build. Its outputs (wwwroot/fonts, _IconSprite.cshtml) are committed, and MSBuild globs Content/Razor items at evaluation time - before any target runs - so regenerating them mid-build lands one build late and silently ships a stale sprite. Run `npm run build:assets` explicitly and commit the result when changing the font packages or the icon list.
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:css:prod && npm run build:ts
scripts.watch: npm run watch:css & npm run watch:ts
